english.toefl: 96 total and 22 speaking (published 0–120 scale); central full status 103 old / 5.0 new
english.note: MCB own IELTS overall minimum 7.0, speaking 7.5; central full status overall 7.5 retained. Only TOEFL/IELTS accepted by MCB. New-scale MCB section threshold not stated; confirm. Limited status possible below full-status threshold. Tests within two years; central exemptions apply.

applicationFee.note: Domestic and international $90 under current central policy. Domestic waivers for eligible categories; international waiver only under approved valid exchange agreement. Program pages generally exclude international waivers. Central exchange-agreement exception means waiver availability is not exclusively domestic; international applicants should confirm approved agreement with Graduate College.

documents: Unofficial credentials for every postsecondary institution; English translations
Two required personal statements (250 words maximum each)
Two optional personal statements (250 words maximum each)
requirements.note: Bachelor's in biological or physical sciences. At least two letters should evaluate scholarship/training/independent research. No research advisor required before application; three five-week rotations in first semester. Authentic essays required; AI-generated responses not accepted.

funding.note: Departments guarantee support with satisfactory degree progress. Fellowships, traineeships or assistantships provide stipend, full tuition and partial fee waiver; no stipend amount on opened pages.
